props.text: Import this project, then open Gateway Settings from Designer or Projects as an administrator. Search for Gateway operations in the application inventory and reopen this Designer from its resource link.
Publish the project and open its operator link. Engineering and operator sign-ins appear as separate sessions. Use only a disposable session for the revocation exercise in the guide.
Open Diagnostics, refresh the snapshot and inspect process memory, available disk and bounded API observations. Download the support JSON and verify that project contents and credentials are absent.
